3dqaum.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure visibility is sufficient to allow the manoeuvre.
3dqaum.why: Before overtaking you need enough clear visibility to complete the manoeuvre safely; otherwise you must not begin.

uuaz00.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure the manoeuvre can be carried out without causing obstruction.
uuaz00.why: Overtaking must not obstruct other road users, so you must check beforehand that the manoeuvre will not get in anyone's way.

rvxsof.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure the driver ahead in the same lane has not signalled that they intend to perform the same manoeuvre.
rvxsof.why: If the driver ahead has signalled that they will overtake too, you must wait, because two overtakes at once create danger.

1fjyoy.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure the driver behind on the same carriageway has not already started to overtake.
1fjyoy.why: You must check that the vehicle behind has not already begun overtaking, otherwise you would pull out into its path.

1rq4e9t.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure the road is clear enough to allow the overtaking to be fully completed.
1rq4e9t.why: The free space must be enough to complete the whole manoeuvre, including moving back in, not just to start it.

10cfkvu.q: A driver who intends to overtake must assess the space needed for the manoeuvre, also in relation to the speed difference between their own vehicle and the one being overtaken.
10cfkvu.why: The space needed depends on the speed difference between the two vehicles: the smaller the difference, the more road you need.

dlh1uk.q: A driver who intends to overtake must take into account any vehicles coming from the opposite direction.
dlh1uk.why: Overtaking means temporarily using the opposite lane, so you must consider oncoming vehicles.

gilz2g.q: A driver who intends to overtake must assess the space needed in relation to the length of their own vehicle and of the one being overtaken.
gilz2g.why: The longer the vehicles, the more room you need to pass and move back in, so the length of both must be considered.

hkgekg.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure the width of the carriageway allows the manoeuvre in safe conditions.
hkgekg.why: The carriageway (carreggiata) must be wide enough to overtake without risk to yourself or others.

1y5jt6n.q: A driver who intends to overtake must make sure no vertical sign prohibits the manoeuvre.
1y5jt6n.why: Before overtaking you must check that no vertical sign, such as a no-overtaking sign, forbids the manoeuvre.

aorfkc.q: A driver who intends to overtake must simply make sure that no vehicle is coming from the opposite direction.
aorfkc.why: Checking for oncoming traffic is not enough: you must also check visibility, road width, signs and the vehicles ahead and behind.

971woj.q: A driver who intends to overtake has, as their only obligation, to activate the direction indicator (turn signal).
971woj.why: Using the indicator (freccia) is required but not enough: you must first check visibility, space, signs and other vehicles.

si0uam.q: A driver who intends to overtake must only make sure there is no sign prohibiting overtaking.
si0uam.why: There are many checks: besides prohibition signs you must verify visibility, free space, road width and the position of other vehicles.

66kr1c.q: Before starting an overtaking manoeuvre, you must activate the direction indicator.
66kr1c.why: You must signal your intention to overtake in advance with the indicator, to warn other road users.

spd6hn.q: Overtaking is normally carried out on the left.
spd6hn.why: The general rule is to overtake on the left; overtaking on the right is allowed only in the cases the law specifies.

oxtmxp.q: Overtaking is carried out keeping an adequate lateral distance from the vehicle being overtaken.
oxtmxp.why: While overtaking you must keep enough sideways clearance from the other vehicle to avoid hitting or startling it.

icy63m.q: After completing an overtaking manoeuvre, the driver must move back to the right as soon as possible without creating danger or obstruction.
icy63m.why: After overtaking you return to the right as soon as possible, but only if this causes no danger or obstruction.

10o3waz.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken must make the overtaking manoeuvre easier and must not accelerate.
10o3waz.why: The driver being overtaken must not speed up and must help the overtaker, for example by keeping to the right.

1vd84h0.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken, on roads with one lane per direction, must keep as close as possible to the right edge.
1vd84h0.why: On single-lane roads the driver being overtaken must move as far to the right edge (margine destro) as possible.

1v2hic2.q: The overtaking manoeuvre must not be carried out if the visible space is insufficient to complete it safely.
1v2hic2.why: If the visible road ahead is not enough to finish the overtake safely, you must not start it.

oi0qk1.q: The overtaking manoeuvre must not be carried out if the carriageway is not wide enough.
oi0qk1.why: On a carriageway that is too narrow, overtaking is unsafe and must not be attempted.

t6lfl0.q: A driver who intends to overtake is required to sound the horn.
t6lfl0.why: To overtake you must signal with the direction indicator; sounding the horn is not an obligation.

hj2qal.q: A driver who intends to begin an overtaking manoeuvre is not required to activate the direction indicator.
hj2qal.why: The indicator must always be switched on before starting to overtake; it is mandatory.

l765w1.q: After overtaking, the vehicle may move immediately back to the right even if it cuts across the path of the vehicle just overtaken.
l765w1.why: Moving back to the right must not cut off the overtaken vehicle or force it to brake; it must be done without danger or obstruction.

ivrq6w.q: The driver of the overtaken vehicle may race the driver of the vehicle that is overtaking.
ivrq6w.why: The driver being overtaken must not speed up or race, but must help the overtaker complete the manoeuvre.

9453c6.q: The overtaking manoeuvre is carried out even if the visible space is insufficient to complete it safely.
9453c6.why: If the visible space is not enough to complete the overtake safely, you must not overtake.

t6ciio.q: After a first overtaking manoeuvre, on roads with at least two lanes per direction, another can be performed without moving back to the right, if no obstruction is caused.
t6ciio.why: On roads with at least two lanes per direction you may overtake a second vehicle without returning to the right, provided you obstruct nobody.

sjr5pa.q: Overtaking must be carried out on the right if the driver of the vehicle to be overtaken has signalled the intention to turn left.
sjr5pa.why: If the vehicle ahead signals a left turn, you pass on the right, because the left side is where it is about to go.

10zdpcv.q: Overtaking must be carried out on the right if, on a one-way road, the driver of the vehicle to be overtaken has signalled the intention to pull over to the left.
10zdpcv.why: On a one-way road, if the vehicle ahead signals it is pulling over to the left, you must overtake on the right.

y4cqmu.q: Overtaking a tram may be done on either side if the road is one-way and the width of the carriageway allows it.
y4cqmu.why: On a one-way road, if the width allows, a tram can be overtaken on either the right or the left.

frbvi3.q: If the tram or trolleybus is stationary, overtaking may be done on the right if there is a refuge island (salvagente).
frbvi3.why: With a stopped tram or trolleybus you may pass on the right only if a refuge island (salvagente) is present.

efvqcp.q: If the tram or trolleybus is stationary, overtaking cannot be done on the right if there is no refuge island (salvagente).
efvqcp.why: Without a refuge island (salvagente) passengers step onto the road, so you cannot pass a stopped tram or trolleybus on the right.

e3x139.q: If the tram or trolleybus is stationary for passengers to board and alight, overtaking may always be done on the right.
e3x139.why: Overtaking a stopped tram on the right is allowed only when a refuge island (salvagente) exists, not always.

wpasdc.q: Overtaking on the right is always forbidden.
wpasdc.why: Overtaking on the right is forbidden as a rule but permitted in specific cases, for example when the vehicle ahead signals a left turn.

dzh9yz.q: Overtaking may, as a rule, be carried out on the right on motorways.
dzh9yz.why: Even on motorways overtaking is normally done on the left; passing on the right is allowed only in the exceptional cases the law lists.

fzcbvo.q: Overtaking may be carried out on the left only if the vehicle to be overtaken is turning right.
fzcbvo.why: Overtaking on the left is the general rule and does not depend on the vehicle ahead turning right.

1916xhq.q: It is forbidden to carry out a second overtaking manoeuvre without first moving back to the right.
1916xhq.why: On roads with at least two lanes per direction a second overtake without moving back right is allowed if it obstructs nobody.

183sdt7.q: Overtaking is forbidden near bends on roads with two lanes and two-way traffic.
183sdt7.why: Near bends visibility is limited, so overtaking is forbidden on two-lane, two-way roads.

1sodqoe.q: Overtaking is forbidden near the crests of hills (dossi) on roads with two lanes and two-way traffic.
1sodqoe.why: You cannot see past a hill crest (dosso), so overtaking is forbidden there on two-lane, two-way roads.

1rqf5tw.q: Overtaking is forbidden in conditions of poor visibility.
1rqf5tw.why: In poor visibility, such as fog, you cannot check the road ahead, so overtaking is forbidden.

xi3glx.q: Overtaking is permitted on bends if the road has two separate carriageways with at least two lanes in each direction.
xi3glx.why: The bend ban does not apply on roads with separate carriageways and two or more lanes per direction, as you do not enter oncoming traffic.

1bpuz3s.q: Overtaking is permitted on hill crests (dossi) if the road has two separate carriageways and two lanes per direction.
1bpuz3s.why: With separate carriageways and two lanes per direction, the ban on overtaking at hill crests does not apply.

f03qxn.q: It is forbidden to overtake a vehicle that is itself overtaking another, if this requires moving to the side reserved for the opposite direction.
f03qxn.why: Overtaking a vehicle that is already overtaking would mean entering the opposite lane, which is dangerous, so it is forbidden.

2hdpw6.q: It is forbidden to overtake vehicles stopped at level crossings if you have to use the opposite half of the carriageway.
2hdpw6.why: At level crossings (passaggi a livello) you must not overtake stopped vehicles if that means using the opposite half of the road.

l7piqt.q: It is forbidden to overtake slow-moving vehicles at level crossings when this requires moving to the side reserved for the opposite direction.
l7piqt.why: At level crossings you must not overtake slow-moving vehicles if you would have to enter the lane of the opposite direction.

1cdbcaq.q: It is forbidden to overtake vehicles stopped at traffic lights when this requires moving to the side reserved for the opposite direction.
1cdbcaq.why: At traffic lights you must not pass stopped vehicles by entering the lane reserved for oncoming traffic.

dvfvn9.q: It is forbidden to overtake slow-moving vehicles due to traffic congestion when this requires moving to the side reserved for the opposite direction.
dvfvn9.why: In congested traffic you must not overtake slow-moving vehicles by using the lane for the opposite direction.

1v88dz6.q: Overtaking is permitted near or at intersections if they are regulated by traffic lights.
1v88dz6.why: The ban on overtaking near intersections does not apply when the intersection is controlled by traffic lights.

1ojyj1a.q: Overtaking on the right is permitted at intersections regulated by traffic lights, if the vehicle to be overtaken has signalled a left turn and has begun the manoeuvre.
1ojyj1a.why: If the vehicle ahead has signalled and begun a left turn, you may pass it on the right even at a signalled intersection.

w8x0kh.q: Overtaking is permitted at intersections if the road has priority, provided it has two separate carriageways and the lanes are marked by the proper road markings.
w8x0kh.why: On a priority road with separate carriageways and marked lanes, overtaking at an intersection is allowed.

da22j7.q: Overtaking is permitted at intersections if you are passing a non-motorised two-wheeled vehicle and you do not enter the side reserved for the opposite direction.
da22j7.why: At intersections you may pass a non-motorised two-wheeler, such as a bicycle, as long as you do not enter the opposite side.

fv7f5u.q: Overtaking is permitted at intersections regulated by traffic officers.
fv7f5u.why: When an intersection is controlled by traffic officers, the ban on overtaking at intersections does not apply.

kjmekw.q: Overtaking is permitted near or at level crossings without barriers if traffic is regulated by traffic lights.
kjmekw.why: At level crossings without barriers overtaking is allowed if traffic is controlled by traffic lights.

1y8rwdh.q: It is forbidden to overtake a vehicle that has stopped at a pedestrian crossing to let pedestrians cross.
1y8rwdh.why: A vehicle stopped at a pedestrian crossing is giving way to pedestrians; overtaking it is forbidden because you cannot see them.

te6pir.q: It is forbidden to overtake a vehicle that has slowed down at a pedestrian crossing to let pedestrians cross.
te6pir.why: Even if the vehicle has only slowed down to let pedestrians cross, overtaking it at the crossing is forbidden.

1vdqk02.q: It is forbidden to overtake on acceleration or deceleration lanes.
1vdqk02.why: Acceleration and deceleration lanes are only for entering or leaving the road, so overtaking on them is forbidden.

dwrzco.q: It is forbidden to overtake if you have to cross a simple or double continuous white longitudinal line.
dwrzco.why: A continuous longitudinal line, single or double, must not be crossed, so overtaking that crosses it is forbidden.

1bn2kv6.q: The space needed for overtaking increases if the vehicle to be overtaken accelerates.
1bn2kv6.why: If the vehicle being overtaken speeds up, the speed difference shrinks and you need more road to pass it.

1okhmuv.q: The space needed for overtaking increases with the greater length of the vehicle to be overtaken.
1okhmuv.why: A longer vehicle takes more space to pass before you can move back in.

xqevgr.q: The space needed for the overtaking manoeuvre increases with the greater length of the overtaking vehicle.
xqevgr.why: The length of the overtaking vehicle also counts: the longer it is, the more space the manoeuvre needs.

17b0sku.q: The space needed for overtaking is greater if there is little difference in speed between the vehicles.
17b0sku.why: With a small speed difference the overtake takes longer, so more free road is needed.

7gzyog.q: The safety distance must be maintained even when starting the overtaking manoeuvre.
7gzyog.why: You must keep your safety distance even when starting to overtake, so you can brake if something unexpected happens.

1p3v38a.q: Overtaking is permitted on the descending part of a hill crest (dosso) on a road with two lanes and two-way traffic.
1p3v38a.why: The ban applies near the crest where sight is limited; on the descending part, where the road ahead is visible, overtaking is allowed.

1tkwp55.q: Before overtaking, it is mandatory to make sure there are no signs prohibiting it.
1tkwp55.why: Before overtaking you must check that no signs prohibit it.

pt2tuc.q: The danger of overtaking comes from the possibility of hitting other vehicles which, ahead or behind, intend to perform the same manoeuvre.
pt2tuc.why: Overtaking is dangerous because vehicles ahead or behind may want to overtake at the same time and collide.

1zxdco.q: It is forbidden to overtake if the vehicle to be passed has stopped to give way to pedestrians, even away from pedestrian crossings.
1zxdco.why: If a vehicle stops to let pedestrians cross, even away from a marked crossing, do not overtake it, as pedestrians may be hidden.

s9cubz.q: It is dangerous to move back in after overtaking if the manoeuvre forces the overtaken vehicles to brake sharply.
s9cubz.why: Moving back in too early forces the overtaken vehicle to brake hard, risking a rear-end collision.

3a3wb1.q: Before moving back into the right lane after overtaking, you must check the position of the overtaken vehicle using the rear-view mirrors.
3a3wb1.why: Before returning to the right lane, check the overtaken vehicle's position in your mirrors so you do not cut it off.

p92dc7.q: Overtaking is permitted in poor visibility as long as you flash your lights during the manoeuvre.
p92dc7.why: In poor visibility overtaking is forbidden; flashing your lights does not remove the ban.

1tx6a9z.q: Overtaking is forbidden on a bend even if the road has two separate carriageways.
1tx6a9z.why: With separate carriageways you do not enter oncoming traffic, so overtaking on a bend is allowed.

vnru4s.q: Overtaking is forbidden on a bend even if the road has at least two lanes per direction.
vnru4s.why: With at least two lanes per direction, overtaking on a bend is allowed because you do not use the opposite lane.

c3w8oy.q: It is permitted to overtake stopped vehicles at level crossings without barriers if the train is far away.
c3w8oy.why: At level crossings overtaking stopped vehicles into the opposite lane is forbidden regardless of how far away the train is.

14spmby.q: It is permitted to overtake slow-moving vehicles at level crossings without barriers if the train is far away.
14spmby.why: At level crossings overtaking slow-moving vehicles is forbidden, whatever the distance of the train.

1bzhdj4.q: Overtaking is permitted at intersections as long as nobody is coming from the right.
1bzhdj4.why: Near intersections overtaking is generally forbidden, with exceptions such as traffic lights or officers; no traffic from the right is not enough.

2f57k1.q: Overtaking is permitted on acceleration lanes as long as the manoeuvre is carried out carefully.
2f57k1.why: Overtaking on acceleration lanes is always forbidden, however carefully it is done.

13m8cjm.q: It is always permitted to overtake a two-wheeled vehicle.
13m8cjm.why: Two-wheelers are subject to the normal overtaking rules: bans still apply, with only limited exceptions such as at intersections.

1130zmi.q: Overtaking is forbidden on one-way roads.
1130zmi.why: On one-way roads overtaking is allowed, even on the right in some cases, provided the road permits it.

k9qee.q: It is forbidden to overtake police vehicles.
k9qee.why: The ban applies only to police vehicles on emergency duty with siren and flashing lights; otherwise overtaking is allowed.

1cdvtuv.q: On the motorway you can overtake on either the right or the left indifferently
1cdvtuv.why: Even on the motorway, overtaking is done on the left as the rule; overtaking on the right is allowed only in the specific exceptional cases set by the code.

1szs3hn.q: Overtaking between motorcycles can be done on either the right or the left
1szs3hn.why: Motorcycles must also overtake on the left; overtaking on the right is allowed only in the specific exceptional cases.

s0knhk.q: The space needed to overtake increases if the vehicle being overtaken slows down
s0knhk.why: If the overtaken vehicle slows down, the speed difference grows and the space needed to overtake gets smaller, not larger.

1iz443y.q: The space needed to overtake is independent of the length of the vehicles
1iz443y.why: The longer the vehicles are, the more space is needed to complete the overtake and return safely, so length does matter.

8brw8m.q: Overtaking a bus stopped for passengers to get on and off is forbidden
8brw8m.why: A bus stopped to let passengers on and off may be overtaken, with due caution; there is no absolute ban.

bjr6ps.q: Overtaking is forbidden on bends and over hill crests on one-way roads
bjr6ps.why: The ban on overtaking at bends and crests (dossi) applies to two-way roads; it does not apply on one-way roads.

j7eg41.q: Overtaking is forbidden if you are forced to cross the dashed longitudinal line
j7eg41.why: A dashed line may be crossed; the prohibition concerns the continuous line.

nu85h5.q: Overtaking motorcycles on the right is allowed if there is enough space
nu85h5.why: Overtaking is done on the left, motorcycles included; having enough room on the right does not make right-side overtaking legal.

sl7p4.q: In heavy traffic motorcyclists are allowed to use reserved lanes to overtake
sl7p4.why: Reserved lanes (e.g. for public transport) cannot be used for overtaking, not even by motorcyclists in heavy traffic.

15mjq0j.q: When starting to overtake you may signal the manoeuvre to vehicles ahead by flashing the main beam headlights
15mjq0j.why: Flashing the main beam headlights (abbaglianti) briefly is a permitted way to warn vehicles ahead that you are overtaking.

xwzcac.q: When overtaking, you must adjust your speed in relation to that of the vehicle being overtaken
xwzcac.why: Your speed must be matched to that of the vehicle being overtaken so that the manoeuvre is completed quickly and safely.

1a820c3.q: To carry out an overtaking manoeuvre in built-up areas you may temporarily exceed the speed limits
1a820c3.why: Speed limits must always be respected, including during an overtake and in built-up areas.

1yqgv26.q: When overtaking you must strictly keep to the right
1yqgv26.why: To overtake you move to the left of the vehicle being overtaken; you return to the right only once the manoeuvre is finished.

1p3focp.q: When carrying out an overtaking manoeuvre you must not accelerate
1p3focp.why: To complete the overtake you need to be faster than the vehicle being overtaken, so you accelerate within the speed limit.

d4bgjb.q: After overtaking you must immediately move back to the right, slowing down
d4bgjb.why: You return to the right as soon as possible, but without causing obstruction or danger and without braking sharply.

5a3nvo.q: Overtaking public service line buses is forbidden
5a3nvo.why: There is no general ban on overtaking scheduled buses; the normal overtaking rules apply.

gx5i1a.q: Overtaking is forbidden when the vehicle ahead has switched on its right turn signal
gx5i1a.why: Overtaking is forbidden when the vehicle ahead signals a left turn or its own overtake; a right indicator does not forbid it.

12n3sgq.q: Overtaking is forbidden when it is snowing
12n3sgq.why: Snow alone does not forbid overtaking; it is forbidden only if visibility is insufficient or other hazards exist.

1gd1g4z.q: Overtaking is forbidden at driveway entrances (passi carrabili)
1gd1g4z.why: Driveway entrances (passi carrabili) do not create any ban on overtaking.

16d9pkj.why: Being near a hospital does not forbid overtaking; a specific sign or dangerous conditions would be needed.

1vs4icu.q: Overtaking is forbidden near service stations
1vs4icu.why: No rule forbids overtaking near service stations.

e1r4hy.q: Overtaking near a hill crest is allowed on one-way roads
e1r4hy.why: On one-way roads there is no oncoming traffic, so the ban on overtaking near crests (dossi) does not apply.

hnjra3.q: Overtaking near a hill crest is allowed on one-way carriageways
hnjra3.why: On one-way carriageways there is no oncoming traffic, so overtaking near crests (dossi) is allowed.

43ooby.q: Overtaking near a hill crest is allowed on roads with two lanes per direction of travel
43ooby.why: With at least two lanes per direction you can overtake without entering the opposite lane, even near crests (dossi).

2a5xrt.q: Overtaking near a hill crest is allowed on roads with two separate carriageways
2a5xrt.why: With separate carriageways there is no oncoming traffic, so overtaking near crests (dossi) is allowed.

ncz1g5.q: It is forbidden to overtake by tailing an ambulance on emergency service
ncz1g5.why: Overtaking by slipstreaming behind an emergency vehicle on urgent duty is forbidden because it is dangerous.

799mhh.q: On two-lane two-way roads near a hill crest, it is allowed to overtake animal-drawn vehicles
799mhh.why: Near crests (dossi) on two-way roads with one lane per direction, overtaking is forbidden for any vehicle, animal-drawn ones included.

1st5lt.q: On two-lane two-way roads near a hill crest, it is allowed to overtake in the slipstream of the vehicle ahead
1st5lt.why: Near a crest (dosso) on a two-way road overtaking is forbidden, even following in the slipstream of the vehicle ahead, because visibility is inadequate.

rsznh0.q: Near a hill crest it is allowed to enter the opposite half of the carriageway to overtake line buses stopped for passengers to get on and off
rsznh0.why: Near a crest (dosso) you may not enter the opposite half of the road to overtake, not even a bus stopped at a stop.

b78nz9.q: You cannot overtake at hill crests on a one-way carriageway with two lanes
b78nz9.why: On a one-way carriageway there is no oncoming traffic, so overtaking at crests (dossi) is allowed.

785bn.q: You cannot overtake a vehicle that has signalled its intention to pull over to the right edge of the carriageway
785bn.why: The ban applies to vehicles signalling a left turn or an overtake; if the vehicle ahead is pulling over to the right, you may overtake it.

1yqzhp6.q: You cannot overtake at the exit of a public car park
1yqzhp6.why: The exit of a public car park does not create a ban on overtaking.

1ymhlm3.q: Overtaking is forbidden if there is a dashed white line next to a continuous one on the left of the vehicle
1ymhlm3.why: What counts is the line nearest to the vehicle: if it is dashed it may be crossed, so overtaking is allowed.

18oeg2q.q: You cannot overtake on the right a tram travelling in the middle of the carriageway
18oeg2q.why: A tram travelling in the middle of the carriageway may be overtaken on the right.

c728c2.q: While overtaking, the driver must avoid squeezing or cutting across the path of the overtaken vehicle
c728c2.why: The overtaking driver must leave enough lateral space and move back in only at a safe distance, without squeezing or cutting off the other vehicle.

1tjxl4d.q: The danger of overtaking is determined by the risk of hitting other vehicles that show the intention to perform the same manoeuvre
1tjxl4d.why: Other vehicles intending to overtake at the same time make the manoeuvre dangerous and can cause collisions.

kqustv.q: The danger of overtaking is determined by the risk of collision, during the approach, with the vehicle to be overtaken
kqustv.why: During the approach you can hit the vehicle being overtaken, especially if it slows or swerves.

13ojz7t.q: The danger of overtaking is determined by the risk of collision, when moving back into lane, with the overtaken vehicle
13ojz7t.why: Moving back too early can hit the overtaken vehicle, which is why enough space must be left.

5f8p7e.q: The danger of overtaking is determined by the risk of head-on collision with a vehicle coming from the opposite direction
5f8p7e.why: Overtaking puts you in the opposite lane, with the risk of a head-on collision with oncoming traffic.

11dtotx.q: The danger of overtaking is determined by the narrow width of the carriageway
11dtotx.why: A narrow carriageway reduces lateral space and increases the risk of collision during overtaking.

13koe6b.q: During overtaking, the driver must stay in the overtaking lane for as long as possible
13koe6b.why: You stay in the overtaking lane only as long as necessary, then return to the right as soon as it is safe.

f3cdos.q: During overtaking, the driver must continuously signal the manoeuvre with the horn
f3cdos.why: The horn is used only to warn of immediate danger; it is not to be sounded continuously to announce an overtake.

kmcwjk.q: During overtaking, the driver must keep a speed at least double that of the overtaken vehicle
kmcwjk.why: No fixed speed ratio is required; you just adjust your speed to finish the overtake safely and within the limit.

vmuwgf.q: The danger of overtaking is determined by the presence on the road of normal edge delineators
vmuwgf.why: Normal edge delineators (delineatori) only mark the road edge and do not make overtaking dangerous.

4lfykn.q: Overtaking is forbidden at night in built-up areas with insufficient public lighting
4lfykn.why: There is no specific ban; overtaking is forbidden only if visibility is insufficient to complete the manoeuvre.

elg758.q: Overtaking is forbidden when the dashed centre line is marked on the carriageway
elg758.why: A dashed centre line may be crossed, so overtaking is allowed if the other conditions permit.

6ky0h6.q: Overtaking is forbidden on mountain roads when preceded by a line bus
6ky0h6.why: There is no specific ban for line buses on mountain roads; the ordinary overtaking rules apply.

1763i7e.q: When moving back in after overtaking on the motorway, the driver must keep at least 100 m from the overtaken vehicle
1763i7e.why: No fixed 100 m distance is required; you move back in when the gap is enough not to hinder the overtaken vehicle.

g3q25s.q: When moving back in after overtaking, the driver must warn the overtaken vehicle with the horn
g3q25s.why: The return to lane is signalled with the turn indicator, not with the horn.

1x0fvbl.q: Overtaking on the right is allowed when a trolleybus is stopped for passengers to get on and off, even if there is no safety island
1x0fvbl.why: A stopped trolleybus may be overtaken on the right only if there is a safety island (salvagente); without one it is forbidden.

11ir2f5.q: Overtaking on the right is allowed when driving on a one-way extra-urban road
11ir2f5.why: Even on one-way roads you overtake on the left; overtaking on the right is allowed only in the specific cases, not in general.

137yg8c.q: The driver intending to overtake must make sure the engine power of their vehicle is greater than that of the vehicle being overtaken
137yg8c.why: The driver must check visibility, space and that the road is clear, not compare engine power.

mb9zvo.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged not to race the overtaking vehicle
mb9zvo.why: The driver being overtaken must not race the overtaking vehicle, so as not to make the manoeuvre dangerous.

a7jokx.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged not to speed up
a7jokx.why: The driver being overtaken must not speed up, so the overtaking vehicle can finish the manoeuvre quickly.

1ypq5xp.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged to stop as soon as possible to let traffic flow if driving a very slow vehicle
1ypq5xp.why: The driver of a very slow vehicle holding up traffic must stop as soon as possible to let the traffic pass.

xbnmgx.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged to keep as close as possible to the right edge on roads with a single lane per direction
xbnmgx.why: The driver being overtaken must keep as far right as possible to make the overtake easier.

kbdxzv.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged to move to the middle of the carriageway to prevent slipstream overtaking
kbdxzv.why: The driver being overtaken must stay to the right, not in the middle of the road, so as not to obstruct the overtake.

1tkf59m.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged to switch on the hazard lights (all indicators flashing) to signal that the road is clear
1tkf59m.why: Hazard lights signal danger or an obstruction; they are not used to tell others the road is clear for overtaking.

szez9u.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged to always reduce their speed
szez9u.why: The driver being overtaken is not required to always slow down: they must not accelerate and must help the manoeuvre, e.g. when oncoming traffic appears.

13b0fuf.q: The driver of the vehicle being overtaken is obliged to engage lower gears to make overtaking easier
13b0fuf.why: There is no obligation to shift to lower gears; the duty is not to accelerate and to facilitate the overtake.

wigftt.q: For overtaking, you must consider that a vehicle towing a caravan can never be overtaken on a steep downhill
wigftt.why: There is no absolute ban on overtaking a vehicle towing a caravan on a steep descent; it simply calls for extra caution.

1qopl4t.q: It is allowed to overtake a Police car that is not on emergency service and where there are no other impediments
1qopl4t.why: A Police car not on emergency duty is an ordinary vehicle and can be overtaken if there are no other obstacles.

k84vdp.q: If you are being overtaken while a vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, it is advisable to reduce speed
k84vdp.why: You should help the overtaker by slowing down, so they can move back in safely.

4934rf.q: If you are being overtaken while a vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, you must move as close as possible to the right edge of the carriageway
4934rf.why: The driver being overtaken must move as far right as possible to give room and help the overtaker return.

1yu6nij.q: If you are overtaken and an accident occurs, you may bear part of the responsibility if you did not do everything possible to facilitate the overtaking manoeuvre
1yu6nij.why: The driver being overtaken has a duty to facilitate the manoeuvre; failing to do so can make them partly liable for an accident.

k23gla.q: It is forbidden to overtake a Police car, not on emergency service, so as not to hinder its progress
k23gla.why: A Police car not on emergency duty can be overtaken like any other vehicle.

1qbmkk4.q: On motorways with three lanes per direction it is allowed to overtake a Police car, even if on emergency service
1qbmkk4.why: Overtaking a Police car on emergency service is never allowed, regardless of the number of lanes.

ki7kv9.q: If you are being overtaken while a vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, you must keep your main beam headlights on as a danger signal
ki7kv9.why: Main beams (abbaglianti) would dazzle other drivers and are not a danger signal; you must instead help the overtake.

10uj52g.q: If you are being overtaken while a vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, you are obliged to keep the same speed
10uj52g.why: In this case you should slow down to help the overtaker move back in, not hold the same speed.

mk180b.q: If you are being overtaken while a vehicle approaches from the opposite direction, you must switch on the right turn indicator as a danger signal
mk180b.why: The right indicator signals a turn, not danger; you should slow down and keep to the right.

145gjmo.q: During an overtake on the motorway, paying little attention to the vehicles behind can cause an accident
145gjmo.why: Before moving left you must check your mirrors: a vehicle behind may already be overtaking at high speed.

1mkw6bp.q: During an overtake on the motorway, insufficient safety distance can cause an accident
1mkw6bp.why: Insufficient safety distance reduces reaction time and leads to rear-end collisions during overtaking.

v2l9bt.q: During an overtake on the motorway, a sudden move into the overtaking lane by one of the vehicles ahead can cause an accident
v2l9bt.why: A vehicle ahead suddenly moving into the overtaking lane can cause a collision or hard braking.

17case5.q: During an overtake on the motorway, staying too long in the overtaking lane can be a hindrance
17case5.why: The overtaking lane must be left as soon as possible, because staying there too long obstructs others who want to overtake.

59a8ij.q: Overtaking on the motorway can cause an accident if done by tailing a vehicle that is overtaking
59a8ij.why: Tailing a vehicle that is overtaking reduces your visibility and room to manoeuvre, and can cause accidents.

5ov40p.q: Overtaking on the motorway can cause an accident if strong crosswinds affect the stability of the vehicles
5ov40p.why: Strong crosswinds can push vehicles sideways, especially tall or light ones, making overtaking dangerous.

jmy6r5.q: Overtaking on the motorway can cause an accident if done near a lay-by (piazzola di sosta)
jmy6r5.why: Being near a lay-by (piazzola di sosta) does not in itself make overtaking dangerous.

zlk84e.q: Overtaking on the motorway can cause an accident if you drive with dipped headlights always on
zlk84e.why: Dipped headlights are compulsory on motorways and do not cause accidents during overtaking.
